Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo this morning — appreciate the clarity on routing and isolation options. A couple of compliance items came up on our side that we need to document as part of procurement:

- SOC 2 status (Type II) and date of most recent report
- Whether Redwood will act as Controller or Processor for Acme Health data
- Sample DPA and which SCC module you'd propose for transfers outside the EEA

Subject: Re: Follow-up: GDPR / SOC 2 questions from today's call

Hi Tom — great speaking with you. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap from Redwood:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II covering our inference and control plane services (audit completed Nov 2025). We can share the AICPA-approved report under NDA — Rishi will coordinate.
- Roles: Redwood operates as a Processor for customer-controlled data in our hosted and dedicated products; customers (Acme) are Controllers. For Private/on-prem deployments we have a different contractual model — happy to discuss if relevant.
- SCCs: For cross-border transfers we typically execute the 2021 EU Standard Contractual Clauses using the Processor-to-Controller module (i.e., the Processor module appropriate to an EU Controller sending data to a Processor outside the EEA). We'll confirm exact module text in the DPA.
- Subprocessors: We maintain a published subprocessor list and provide 30-day notice for material changes. Dev will attach the current list and indicate critical subprocessors used for hosting and logging.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll send a Redwood DPA draft (v1) and our suggested SCC module for your legal review by end of day Monday (Apr 5).
2) Rishi will share the SOC 2 report under NDA (please share your NDA contact if you want it).
3) Dev will answer the vendor questionnaire items and attach the current subprocessor CSV.
4) If Acme prefers Module X instead, flag that in your reply — we can accommodate with minimal edits.

Do you want us to send the DPA as a DocuSign when ready?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
